  <title><![CDATA[Why are European banks moving gold out of United States?]]></title>
  <updated>2026-09-12T15:32:00Z</updated>
  <published>2026-09-12T15:32:00Z</published>
  <rights>2026 DW</rights>
  <link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://www.dw.com/en/why-are-european-banks-moving-gold-out-of-united-states/a-79213013?maca=en-rss-en-top-1022-xml-atom"/>
  <summary><![CDATA[The Netherlands and France have moved their gold out of US vaults. Part of the reason is fears about the reliability of the US, but equally important is the need to keep gold closer to home in the event of a crisis.]]></summary>

  <title><![CDATA[Corals as climate archive: Are El Ninos intensifying?]]></title>
  <updated>2026-09-12T08:53:00Z</updated>
  <published>2026-09-12T08:53:00Z</published>
  <rights>2026 DW</rights>
  <link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://www.dw.com/en/corals-as-climate-archive-are-el-ninos-intensifying/a-79243425?maca=en-rss-en-top-1022-xml-atom"/>
